//: What only Python has, added to the docstrings that scripts/python-docstrings.mjs writes from the TSDoc comments (#29): the shapes and dtypes of the NumPy arrays. Keys are the Python names; a function gets {type, doc} as its Returns section, a constant a string as its last paragraph.

symcrys.LATTICE_SYMMETRY_DIRECTIONS: In Python: family → one int64 array of shape (n, 3) per position, the n directions [uvw] as rows.

operations.doc: Dicts ``{"matrix"}``; each matrix is a float64 array of shape (3, 3).

generators.doc: Dicts ``{"matrix"}``; each matrix is a float64 array of shape (3, 3).

lattice_basis.doc: A float64 array of shape (3, 3), a new array on each call; a, b, c are its columns.

describe_operations.doc: In each, ``axis`` (if present) has ``lattice`` (int64, shape (3,)) and ``cartesian`` (float64, shape (3,)).

symmetry_directions.doc: Each entry of ``directions`` has ``lattice`` (int64, shape (3,)) and ``cartesian`` (float64, shape (3,)).

site_symmetry.doc: ``operations`` int64 array of shape (n,), ``direction`` float64 array of shape (3,), ``multiplicity``, ``general``.

wyckoff_positions.doc: In each, ``representative`` has ``hkl`` (int64, shape (3,)) and ``cartesian`` (float64, shape (3,)), ``site_symmetry_operations`` is an int64 array of shape (n,).

wyckoff_position_of.doc: ``representative`` has ``hkl`` (int64, shape (3,)) and ``cartesian`` (float64, shape (3,)), ``site_symmetry_operations`` is an int64 array of shape (n,).

crystal_forms.doc: In each, ``representative`` has ``hkl`` (int64, shape (3,)) and ``cartesian`` (float64, shape (3,)).

tensor_form.doc: ``basis`` float64 array of shape (p, 3**rank), ``parameters`` int64 array of shape (p, rank), ``relations`` float64 array of shape (3**rank - p, 3**rank), ``rank``; p is the number of free parameters. A row of ``basis`` reshaped to ``(3,) * rank`` is a tensor.

tensor_form_of.doc: ``basis`` float64 array of shape (p, 3**rank), ``parameters`` int64 array of shape (p, rank), ``relations`` float64 array of shape (3**rank - p, 3**rank), ``rank``; p is the number of free parameters.

rotate_tensor.doc: A float64 array of shape (3**rank,); ``tensor`` may have any shape with 3**rank entries (it is flattened in C order).

lattice_operations.doc: Dicts ``{"matrix"}``; each matrix is a float64 array of shape (3, 3) holding integers (the fixed rule for matrices).

orbit.doc: In each, ``hkl`` (or ``uvw``) is an int64 array of shape (3,) and ``operations`` an int64 array of shape (n,); ``indices`` is a dict ``{"hkl": ...}`` or ``{"uvw": ...}``.

orbit_of.doc: In each, ``direction`` is a float64 array of shape (3,) and ``operations`` an int64 array of shape (n,).

symcrys.magnetic.LATTICE_SYMMETRY_DIRECTIONS: In Python: family → one int64 array of shape (n, 3) per position, the n directions [uvw] as rows.

operations.doc: Dicts ``{"matrix", "time_reversal"}``; each matrix is a float64 array of shape (3, 3).

generators.doc: Dicts ``{"matrix", "time_reversal"}``; each matrix is a float64 array of shape (3, 3).

lattice_basis.doc: A float64 array of shape (3, 3), a new array on each call; a, b, c are its columns.

describe_operations.doc: In each, ``axis`` (if present) has ``lattice`` (int64, shape (3,)) and ``cartesian`` (float64, shape (3,)).

symmetry_directions.doc: Each entry of ``directions`` has ``lattice`` (int64, shape (3,)) and ``cartesian`` (float64, shape (3,)).

site_symmetry.doc: ``operations`` int64 array of shape (n,), ``direction`` float64 array of shape (3,), ``multiplicity``, ``general``.

tensor_form.doc: ``basis`` float64 array of shape (p, 3**rank), ``parameters`` int64 array of shape (p, rank), ``relations`` float64 array of shape (3**rank - p, 3**rank), ``rank``; p is the number of free parameters. A row of ``basis`` reshaped to ``(3,) * rank`` is a tensor.

tensor_form_of.doc: ``basis`` float64 array of shape (p, 3**rank), ``parameters`` int64 array of shape (p, rank), ``relations`` float64 array of shape (3**rank - p, 3**rank), ``rank``; p is the number of free parameters.

rotate_tensor.doc: A float64 array of shape (3**rank,); ``tensor`` may have any shape with 3**rank entries (it is flattened in C order).

lattice_operations.doc: Dicts ``{"matrix", "time_reversal"}``; each matrix is a float64 array of shape (3, 3) holding integers (the fixed rule for matrices).

orbit.doc: In each, ``hkl`` (or ``uvw``) is an int64 array of shape (3,) and ``operations`` an int64 array of shape (n,); ``indices`` is a dict ``{"hkl": ...}`` or ``{"uvw": ...}``.

orbit_of.doc: In each, ``direction`` is a float64 array of shape (3,) and ``operations`` an int64 array of shape (n,).

plane_group.doc: ``centring`` is a float64 array of shape (n, 2), n = 0 or 1.

operations.doc: Dicts ``{"matrix", "translation"}``: float64 arrays of shape (2, 2) and (2,).

generators.doc: Dicts ``{"matrix", "translation"}``: float64 arrays of shape (2, 2) and (2,).

describe_operations.doc: ``translation``, ``location`` and ``glide`` (where present) are float64 arrays of shape (2,), ``direction`` and ``normal`` int64 arrays of shape (2,).

describe_operations_of.doc: As ``describe_operations``: ``translation``, ``location`` and ``glide`` (where present) float64 arrays of shape (2,), ``direction`` and ``normal`` int64 arrays of shape (2,).

site_symmetry.doc: ``operations`` int64 array of shape (n,), ``point`` float64 array of shape (2,), ``multiplicity``, ``general``.

snap_to_wyckoff_position.doc: ``letter``, ``multiplicity``, ``site_symmetry``, ``coordinates`` as in ``wyckoff_positions``, and ``point`` a float64 array of shape (2,).

orbit.doc: A float64 array of shape (n, 2), the images as rows.

asymmetric_unit.doc: ``vertices`` a float64 array of shape (n, 2), ``inequalities`` an int64 array of shape (n, 3).

symmetry_elements.doc: ``rotations``: dicts ``{"order", "point"}``, point a float64 array of shape (2,); ``lines``: dicts ``{"kind", "direction", "normal", "glide", "segment"}``, direction and normal int64 of shape (2,), glide float64 of shape (2,), segment float64 of shape (2, 2), the two ends as rows.
